integration: Trace v6 carries two cumulative eight-owner checkpoints (pre/post storage), four little-endian u16 fields per owner. Geometry owners claim byte-record buffers using (generation + owner*OFFSET_STRIDE) mod (capacity+1), populate source_tick + owner*OFFSET_STRIDE + index modulo 256, consume their concatenation into the scene CRC, then release. This is bounded diagnostic storage, not production geometry. Track owners count first populated slots without changing the 24-slot workload. PCM observes the actual channel-0 on/off state (other channels remain off); cache observes valid bytes only after successful refill. Observation state is not reset across storage.
observation: The subsystem owner supplies current occupancy, including zero, after every relevant occupancy transition. An observer records peak, sample count and full-capacity sample count. It does not allocate, release, evict, steal a voice, drop work or select a policy. Full occupancy is an observation, not a universal acceptance failure or success. Capacity is immutable between explicit initializations. Invalid state, out-of-range occupancy or counter overflow rejects without mutation; the caller must treat rejection as invalid evidence, never saturation or omission.
scope: Candidate actual-owner integration with separately qualified native tests. Fixture capacities are not production geometry/audio-cache limits. Track occupancy means populated scalar fixture slots, not production sensor allocation. PCM occupancy covers channel zero only; four-channel contention is not established. Domain observers cannot mutate each other's state. Single foreground owner; no concurrency/IRQ atomicity guarantee. Native state is not serialized. Trace version 6 is private field-wise encoding. Full resident fit and fresh target timing are gates before execution; implementation alone proves neither.
